ddl.value:
(
        ("actor_type" = 'system' and "actor_user_id" is null and "actor_api_key_id" is null)
        or ("actor_type" = 'user' and "actor_user_id" is not null and "actor_api_key_id" is null)
        or ("actor_type" = 'api_key' and "actor_user_id" is null and "actor_api_key_id" is not null)
      )
ddl.name: audit_log_actor_shape_check

ddl.value:
(
        "event_id" is null
        or (
          "resource_type" = 'usage_event'
          and "resource_id" = "event_id"::text
        )
      )
      and (
        "type" <> 'usage_event.process'
        or "event_id" is not null
      )
ddl.name: jobs_event_reference_shape_check

ddl.value:
(
        (
          "status" = 'processing'
          and "lease_owner" is not null
          and "lease_expires_at" is not null
          and "completed_at" is null
        )
        or (
          "status" = 'pending'
          and "lease_owner" is null
          and "lease_expires_at" is null
          and "completed_at" is null
        )
        or (
          "status" in ('completed', 'failed')
          and "lease_owner" is null
          and "lease_expires_at" is null
          and "completed_at" is not null
        )
      )
ddl.name: jobs_lease_shape_check

ddl.value:
(
        ("correction_of_event_id" is null and "correction_kind" is null)
        or (
          "correction_of_event_id" is not null
          and "correction_kind" is not null
          and "correction_of_event_id" <> "id"
        )
      )
ddl.name: usage_events_correction_shape_check

ddl.value: cardinality("scopes") > 0 and array_position("scopes", null) is null and array_position("scopes", '') is null
ddl.name: api_keys_scopes_not_empty_check
